acs.text:
Given `markdown.markdown('x', extensions=['external_links'])`, when it is called, then no exception is raised and the result is `

x

`.
Given `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['external_links'])`, when it is constructed, then no exception is raised.

Given no extensions, when `[a](https://example.com)` is converted, then the result is `

a

`.

Given no extensions, when `` is converted, then the result is `

https://example.com

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[a](https://example.com)` is converted, then the result is `

a

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[a](http://example.com)` is converted, then the result is `

a

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[a][1]` with the definition `[1]: https://example.com` is converted, then the `<a>` element in the result contains `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `` is converted, then the result is `

https://example.com

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[a](page.html)` is converted, then the result is `

a

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[a](#top)` is converted, then the result is `

a

`.
Given extension `external_links`, when `[a](mailto:me@example.com)` is converted, then the result contains neither `target=` nor `rel=`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `![a](https://example.com/i.png)` is converted, then the result is `

`.

Given extension `external_links`, when `[![a](https://example.com/i.png)](page.html)` is converted, then the `` element has no `target` attribute and no `rel` attribute, and the `` element has none either.
Given `md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['external_links'])`, when `md.registeredExtensions[0].getConfigs()` is called, then the result is `{}`.
Given `markdown.Markdown(extensions=['external_links'], extension_configs={'external_links': {'target': '_self'}})`, when it is constructed, then a `KeyError` is raised.

questions.title: Existing target or rel on an external link
questions.question: When an external link already has `target` or `rel` (for example from `attr_list`), which wins?
questions.options: (a) existing value is kept (b) extension value overwrites (c) `rel` merged, `target` kept (d) Other

questions.title: Uppercase schemes and protocol-relative links
questions.question: Are `HTTP://example.com` and `//example.com` external?
questions.options: (a) neither is external, exact lowercase prefix only (b) uppercase schemes are external, `//` is not (c) both are external (d) Other
